parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set routing-instances vpna instance-type.explanation: 配置路由实例的类型为VRF。

set routing-instances vpna route-disting.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由区分器。

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: 路由区分器，用于区分不同VPN的路由。

set protocols isis level 1 wide-metrics-.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议，仅使用宽度量。

set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.5.1.2/30
set interfaces ge-1/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-instances vpna interface ge-.explanation: Configure a routing instance and associate an interface with it

parameters.name: routing-instance name
parameters.explanation: The name of the routing instance

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be associated with the routing instance
